main.description: An ordered, curated collection of npm packages. Consumers should render an item whose subjectRef is neither a package URL nor a dev.npmx.collection AT-URI as unresolvable rather than reject the whole collection.

subjectRef.description: Either a package, as https://npmx.dev/package/<name> with the name as published, not URL-encoded (the same identifier dev.npmx.feed.like uses), or the AT-URI of another dev.npmx.collection record to include it. Consumers expanding included collections should stop at 2 levels, detect cycles, and treat an unresolvable include as empty.

note.description: Why this item is in the collection.
